items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: People like Drake and Walker, Swarn and Lee, Red and Struggy -- what's that guy's name -- Orson Fry.

ctx.x: What had happened to all of the other stars? Had they either passed away, or there just weren't really that many good people up there? What was happening in Harlem?
Yeah. Well, there was a few of them there. People like Drake and Walker, Swarn and Lee, Red and Struggy -- what's that guy's name -- Orson Fry. People like that.
